messages:
sophie_procurement: FYI vendor just updated lead times for the mid-July H100 batch -- now 10-12 weeks (was 6-8) and they have a 30% allocation cut on our PO. Need a quick plan for Dedicated pools + topoff priorities.
ryan_ops: Ugh. Which regions impacted? Can we stagger?
sophie_procurement: They said global, but EU/US prioritized; APAC gets pushed. They offered partial air shipment for high-priority serials if we cover incremental freight.
kai_vendor: hi team, correct — allocation re-prioritized due to upstream wafer yield. We can air-ship up to 40 units next ship-cycle, needs sign-off on freight + insurance. We can also split RMA replacements separately (faster turn for DOAs).
jess_hw: @kai_vendor can we get the list of serials eligible for air? We need to match against pending RMAs and Dedicated reservations before committing.
kai_vendor: sending CSV in DM, but quick note: air candidate SKUs are from PO 8921 only. No cross-P0 swaps.
ryan_ops: OK. Sophie, recommend: 1) carve out air topoff for Dedicated critical pools (50% of our immediate shortage), 2) hold noncritical dev/test fills to Q4, 3) spin up temp on-demand cloud for bursts. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sophie_procurement: Agree. Also need legal on freight/insurance delta. Kai — what's the ETA for AWB and manifest once we greenlight air?
kai_vendor: if you confirm by EOD we can lock shipping window and provide AWB within 48h. We'll need the ship-to addresses and customs PIC.
shipping-bot: Automated note: when moving to air, add incoterm FCA and set insurance value to PO net + 10% for customs.
jess_hw: On RMAs: we have ~12 pending DOAs in the EU pool. Can we request vendor to prioritize replacement for those serials separate from the air topoff? Otherwise we risk double-allocating.
kai_vendor: yes, RMA replacements are on a separate SLA lane. We can expedite the DOA replacements within 7-10 business days (air if urgent) but they count against RMA replacement inventory, not new PO air.
sophie_procurement: Good — please provide a short manifest of which serials are RMA vs new-ship so ops can reconcile. Also we want a price addendum for the air freight charges.
kai_vendor: will share manifest + proforma freight by EOD.
ryan_ops: Quick ops ask: can you mark the air candidate serials with batch timestamps so our KV cache/node pinning won't mis-route runtime pools once they arrive? (we tag nodes by hw serials).
jess_hw: Also we need to confirm which serials have current firmware that matches our fleet baseline. If not, we need depot staging for FW flash before joining Dedicated pools.
kai_vendor: we'll include firmware metadata where available. Any mismatch will be flagged; staging possible at EU depot for up to 48h.
sophie_procurement: Logistics question: if we accept air and RMA lanes simultaneously, are there customs/insurance conflicts (two separate shipments to same depot)?
shipping-bot: Automated note: multiple inbound shipments to same depot require unique AWB per shipment and consolidated customs invoice for HS classification. Insurance claims are per-AWB. Recommend single consolidated inbound for lower brokerage if timing allows.
ryan_ops: Sounds like we should: A) Approve air for 40 units (confirm addresses + insurance), B) Request RMA replacement manifest ASAP, C) Hold low-priority dev fills. Sophie, can you get legal sign-off on freight/insurance by EOD?
sophie_procurement: I'll loop in legal. @kai_vendor please proceed to prepare manifest + proforma. I'll post final decision here after legal confirms. :white_check_mark:
kai_vendor: on it. Thanks everyone.
ryan_ops: One last thing — timeline for rolling these into Dedicated pools? We should plan a 24h staging + health-check window to avoid capacity blips.
jess_hw: Agreed. We'll run a smoke test and KV integrity check during staging. If any serial fails, we'll trigger RMA lane.
sophie_procurement: Perfect. I'll update the purchase amendment draft and ping legal. If we don't hear back by 18:00 UTC, we'll proceed with partial air to avoid losing the slot.
shipping-bot: Automated reminder scheduled for 17:30 UTC to check manifest delivery.
